meta.name: copy-editing
meta.description: When the user wants to edit, review, or improve existing marketing copy, or refresh outdated content. Also use when the user mentions 'edit this copy,' 'review my copy,' 'copy feedback,' 'proofread,' 'polish this,' 'make this better,' 'copy sweep,' 'tighten this up,' 'this reads awkwardly,' 'clean up this text,' 'too wordy,' 'sharpen the messaging,' 'refresh this content,' 'update this page,' 'this content is outdated,' or 'content audit.' Use this when the user already has copy and wants it improved or refreshed rather than rewritten from scratch. For writing new copy, see copywriting.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 润色和优化现有营销文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你已有营销文案需要改进或刷新
copy.tagline_en: Polish and improve existing marketing copy
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have existing marketing copy that needs improvement or refresh

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照“七遍扫描法”逐步优化你的营销文案，依次检查清晰度、语气、价值、证据、具体性、情感和风险，最后用专家小组评分确保质量。
howto.when: 当你提供现有文案并要求编辑、审阅或改进时触发，例如说“编辑这段文案”或“帮我润色一下”。

say.text: 帮我审阅这段产品介绍，看看哪里可以更清晰。
say.note: Claude 会从清晰度开始扫描。

say.text: 检查一下这封邮件的语气是否一致。
say.note: Claude 会检查语气和品牌一致性。

say.text: 给这段文案做一次完整的七遍扫描。
say.note: Claude 会执行全部七个扫描步骤。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will systematically improve your marketing copy using the 'Seven Sweeps' framework: clarity, voice & tone, so what, prove it, specificity, heightened emotion, and zero risk, followed by an expert panel scoring for high-stakes content.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide existing copy and ask for editing, review, or improvement, e.g., 'edit this copy' or 'polish this.'

say_en.text: Review this product description and suggest clarity improvements.
say_en.note: Claude starts with the Clarity sweep.

say_en.text: Check the tone consistency of this email.
Run a full seven-sweep edit on this landing page.
